purpose: Static inventory of authored DrainInfo amounts, post-construction rewrites, and incoming player-hit forwarding in the final generated Go trees. This records source behavior only; it does not claim game verification.
inventoryMethod: Searched both generated internal and pkg trees for DrainInfo literals, .Amount assignments, Player.Drain calls, and the Drain forwarding method; statically followed local amount definitions and Dehya/Nilou special hit paths.

sharedApplication.sourceHost: When configured, Character.Drain samples prior/current HP and MaxHP and calls Bridge.PlayerDrain(di, currentHP, maxHP); writes returned HP ratio. It logs and emits OnPlayerHPDrain afterward. Without SourceHost, subtracts di.Amount directly.
sharedApplication.sharedFormulaBoundary: The shared player-drain calculation receives finalized di.Amount plus HP state and calculates the resulting HP ratio. It does not derive the character/attack-specific amount. Existing native OnPlayerPreHPDrain callbacks can mutate amount before that shared calculation.
sharedApplication.currentPlayerHitForwarding: pkg/avatar/avatar.go:29-60 emits OnPlayerHit, calculates incoming damage, applies shields, calls Player.Drain with the post-shield remainder if positive, then records PlayerApplied and restores CurrentPlayerAttackID.

producers.origin: Explicit zero; a self-application event marker, not numeric HP loss.
producers.timing: Burst-linked event callback; active character index captured immediately before Drain.
producers.gates_state: Dori self-application; the adjacent TODO says to replace with a single-target attack when self reactions are implemented.

producers.origin: Per-iteration live current HP (not MaxHP); each character sampled immediately before its own drain.
producers.timing: C6 Pneuma branch; iterates current party, sequential drains can affect later reads only for the same character occurrence (each character appears once).
producers.gates_state: Only Pneuma branch; c6Count increment follows the loop.

producers.origin: Per-ally MaxHP read after live CurrentHPRatio gate; hpDrainRatio is supplied by caller (trace required to caller-specific value).
producers.timing: Sequential party loop; skips HP ratio <= 0.5 and counts eligible allies before burst-invulnerability skip. Active character in BurstState is not drained.
producers.gates_state: Dynamic current HP ratio, active slot, current action state, argument hpDrainRatio.

producers.amount: initially 0.15 * maxHP; if (currentHP - hpdrain) / maxHP <= hpDrainThreshold, replace with currentHP - hpDrainThreshold * maxHP
producers.origin: Task callback one frame after hitmark; currentHP and maxHP are sampled inside delayed callback, not at action queue time.
producers.timing: After the plunge hit callback; optionally queues Man Chai based on live burst status/current HP ratio, then checks current HPRatio > threshold and calculates bounded drain.
producers.gates_state: Live burst status/HP threshold; HP drain leaves at least hpDrainThreshold fraction according to sampled maxHP.
producers.shared: Drain application only; local cap arithmetic remains native.

producers.origin: Live current HP read at skill activation after queueing A1 task.
producers.timing: Immediate skill method before zero-damage attack queue.
producers.gates_state: Skill use; no additional local cap in this producer.

producers.amount: initially 0.3 * currentHP; if (currentHP - hpdrain) / maxHP <= hpDrainThreshold, replace with currentHP - hpDrainThreshold * maxHP
producers.origin: CurrentHP and MaxHP captured at Skill entry after CurrentHPRatio threshold check.
producers.timing: Immediate skill call; calls Drain before constructing/queuing the hit AttackInfo.
producers.gates_state: Only if live CurrentHPRatio > hpDrainThreshold; preserves hpDrainThreshold of sampled MaxHP.
producers.shared: Drain application only; local threshold/cap stays source-owned.

producers.origin: Live CurrentHP sampled each scheduled skillDrain callback.
producers.timing: At each recursively scheduled drain tick; count==4 returns before drain, then queues next tick one second later.
producers.gates_state: Tick count controls number of drains; each tick re-reads current HP, so prior drains/other effects change later values.

producers.amount: initially propSurplusHPDrainRatio * maxHP; if (currentHP - hpdrain) / maxHP <= propSurplusHPDrainThreshold, replace with currentHP - propSurplusHPDrainThreshold * maxHP
producers.origin: CurrentHP/MaxHP captured after CurrentHPRatio checks; threshold equality has a rounding-tolerance rejection.
producers.timing: Aimed-shot release; drain occurs before Prop Surplus stack increment.
producers.gates_state: Rejects below threshold and near-equality; cap leaves threshold HP ratio.

producers.origin: MaxHP sampled when the charged attack consume callback runs.
producers.timing: If current HP ratio > 0.5, drain immediately, then queue consumeHp task.
producers.gates_state: Live HPRatio > 0.5; queue and later consumption ordering matters.

producers.timing: Skill callback after an attack/setup call; active index captured before event marker.
producers.gates_state: Event marker for Tengu Juurai: Ambush. Adjacent native TODO requests replacing it with a single-target attack.

producers.origin: Live CurrentHP sampled at the Suffusion drain point.
producers.timing: During skill sequence; subsequent code accumulates consumed HP for end-of-skill bonus, so drain event ordering feeds later state.
producers.gates_state: Suffusion path; A4 tracking below this call observes HP consumed through this skill.

producers.origin: MaxHP sampled when Chilling Penalty's HP-loss callback proceeds past its ICD guard.
producers.timing: Status/ICD is set before immediate drain.
producers.gates_state: Only while skill status and its HP-loss condition permit; skillLoseHPICDKey is written before the call.

producers.origin: Burst talent-level table multiplier times live CurrentHP at periodic callback.
producers.timing: Periodic callback checks burst status and frame ICD; updates hpICD to current frame+60 before draining.
producers.gates_state: Burst status and 60-frame internal timing gate; repeated drains use post-prior-drain CurrentHP.

producers.origin: Incoming DrainInfo.Amount supplied by upstream player-hit/drain path; mitigation multiplier comes from skill-level table. beforeAmount captures original, mitigation is accumulated in c.skillRedmanesBlood before amount rewrite.
producers.timing: OnPlayerPreHPDrain hook runs before Character.Drain/SourceHost.PlayerDrain. Executes before logging, status apply and possible task queue.
producers.gates_state: External only; amount > 0; Dehya field active; player within area; not Dehya self-DoT; cumulative Redmane's Blood below 2*current MaxHP. On a qualifying hit, Redmane pool increases by mitigation, then amount is reduced/clamped.
producers.shared: Shared drain receives the rewritten finalized amount. Hook formula/state is not represented by the aggregate PlayerDrain rule.
producers.nativeTODO: Comments state corrosion likely will not be simulated; retriggering self-DoT interval behavior is uncertain. Do not infer verified mechanics.

producers.amount: dmg = skillRedmanesBlood * skillSelfDoTRatio; if A1 status active, dmg *= 1 - a1ReductionMult; then shields compute dmgLeft and DrainInfo.Amount=dmgLeft
producers.origin: Stored c.skillRedmanesBlood pool, native ratio constant, optional A1 multiplier. AttackInfo is physical FlatDmg; source snapshot is created from that attack before OnPlayerHit.
producers.timing: Self-DoT consumes/reset stored pool in the preceding function code; optional A1 adjustment; creates hit/snapshot; emits OnPlayerHit; applies player shields; drains positive remainder as External. Self-hit has special ability name and is excluded from Dehya mitigation hook.
producers.gates_state: Periodic queued task and current pool/status; A1 state determines reduction. Shield state and active character are passed to OnDamage.
producers.shared: OnPlayerHit/shield/post-shield Drain path is shared at avatar level for ordinary player attacks, but this bespoke off-field path manually repeats event/shield/drain handling; finalized Drain amount enters shared PlayerDrain.
producers.nativeTODO: Source says the system is not designed to hit an off-field character directly; uses a hack. Comment asserts true physical damage makes enemy damage formula/resistance irrelevant. Treat as native implementation comments, not verified mechanic.

producers.amount: ai.FlatDmg = 0.02 * ai.FlatDmg, using the just-created Dendro core Bloom attack; queued as a player-target-only AttackInfo. The eventual DrainInfo.Amount is the post-player-damage, post-shield remainder (avatar.go:48-56), not this raw 2% directly.
producers.origin: dendrocore.NewBloomAttack(char,b,...) returns ai and snap at core explosion; self-hit reuses those values, appends SelfDamageSuffix, mutates FlatDmg to 2% and changes target mask. Damage then goes through player AttackEvent calculation and mitigation/shield path.
producers.timing: Core expiry or kill triggers closure; delayed task queues normal core hit then queues player-only self-hit using same ai/snap; OnPlayerHit occurs at avatar HandleAttack before calc; shield resolution precedes Drain.
producers.gates_state: Expiry/kill callback; player target mask excludes enemy/gadget; Bountiful Core creator/source char and bloom attack snapshot retained.
producers.shared: Not a direct DrainInfo producer. It reaches common avatar incoming player-hit drain and shared PlayerDrain only after damage calculation and shield resolution.
producers.nativeTODO: Source contains FIXME on BountifulCore attack tag and TODO in avatar that player reactions are unimplemented. This inventory does not claim player-resistance/reaction behavior is verified.

otherForwardingAndWrites.expression: Amount=dmgLeft after Shields.OnDamage(activeChar, activeChar, dmg, atk.Info.Element)
otherForwardingAndWrites.ordering: OnPlayerHit -> calc -> shield absorption -> Drain if remainder > 0 -> SourceHost.PlayerApplied; player attack ID is installed around shield/drain and restored afterward.
otherForwardingAndWrites.coverage: This is shared infrastructure for Nilou self-hit and ordinary player hits, not an authored ability drain formula.

otherForwardingAndWrites.kind: Drain dispatch and mutable pre-drain hook
otherForwardingAndWrites.coverage: Dehya's pre-drain hook is the only nonliteral direct Amount rewrite found in either generated tree.

otherForwardingAndWrites.expression: SourceHost.PlayerDrain(di, CurrentHP(), MaxHP()) or native ModifyHPByAmount(-di.Amount)
otherForwardingAndWrites.coverage: Shared HP-state arithmetic consumes amount; does not derive upstream producer formulas.

scanConclusion.laneDifferences: The scanned DrainInfo producers/writes and special Dehya/Nilou paths are materially identical in classic b4 and stellar a7. Paths/line numbers align for listed entries.
scanConclusion.limits: Static source inventory only. Runtime behavior, game-version fidelity, exact damage-to-HP mechanics, and native TODOs are not elevated to game verified. Furina hpDrainRatio call-site values and dendrocore.NewBloomAttack internal formula are intentionally identified as upstream dependencies rather than guessed here.
